headline: Resolution appointing assistant election officials for the November 3rd State General Election.
summary: The meeting will consider a resolution to appoint assistant election officials for the November 3rd State General Election. It is on the consent agenda, with a recommended action to waive the reading and adopt the resolution.
items: Resolution appointing assistant election officials for the November 3rd, State General Election (Councilor Traverse)
